band_joint_identity: In band reports, joint is identical to full by construction for per-cell metrics; joint only has independent meaning in scan conclusions that include inter-mode K5
joint_scaling_rule: QT-3 for scan: joint coordinate is dimensionless lambda; lambda=1 perturbs every same-channel mode by its own worst CI90 endpoint. Band rows canonicalize joint to full for per-cell metrics.

safety_published.rule: min over supported variants; bracket rows use conservative lo; joint uses QT-3 lambda directly
